name: Ctrl+Alt+Click collects an item appearance (#11001)
contract: Ctrl+Alt+Click on a bag item with an uncollected appearance opens CONFIRM_COLLECT_APPEARANCE; accepting it calls
the item's u64 GUID and waits for SMSG_COLLECT_ITEM_APPEARANCE_RESULT (0x06EB, opcode 1771). The server never
queued or handled 0x06EA, so the request was dropped and nothing was collected (#11001, #11085, #11275, #11329,
#11331). Expected: a carried Sentinel's Blade 450934 (ItemAppearances 450934 -> 24009) is answered with
COLLECT_ITEM_APPEARANCE_OK, and a carried Linen Cloth 2589, which has no appearance, with
COLLECT_ITEM_APPEARANCE_FAILED. Collecting leaves a Bind-on-Equip Old Amani Waraxe 467 (ItemAppearances
467 -> 11962) unbound. CoA.UnlockLocalAppearanceCatalog collects every appearance locally, so the added
appearance itself is not observed here.

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: the collect request is accepted
Collecting leaves the blade in the bags
SETUP: the Bind-on-Equip Old Amani Waraxe is unbound
Collect the Old Amani Waraxe appearance
SETUP: the Old Amani Waraxe collect request is accepted
